verdict.rationale: Pipecat is a voice-agent framework, so post-call structured data extraction is a fair question for it, but the evidence shows no such capability. It only offers developer building blocks: turn events for collecting transcript messages, and Flows functions that call external APIs. The telephony webhook mentioned is the carrier's inbound-call webhook, not an outbound post-call delivery of outcomes, entities or dispositions. These do not count as the capability itself.

support.subject: As a developer, I can extract structured data from every call — outcomes, entities, dispositions — delivered via API or webhook after the call
